svg.text: Web app · Mobile-first responsive · Hebrew RTL · 20 screens
· Upcoming event hero card (countdown + task progress bar)
· Budget summary: spent / total / gift income / breakeven delta
· Selected vendors chips (horizontal scroll, status badges)
reads: Couple · Events · Tasks · Vendors · Budget
· Event pill tabs (חתונה / חינה / מסיבה / שב"ח)
· 2×2 RSVP stats grid (total / confirmed / pending / cancelled)
· Guest rows grouped by מי הזמין (section headers)
· Avatar circle + name + RSVP status badge
· 5 section cards: contact / RSVP / events / assign / notes
· Event pill tabs + 7 category filter chips (scroll): all / vendors / payments / clothing / grooming / logistics / misc
· Task rows: checkbox | category icon | name | status badge | due date tag | RTL chevron ‹
· Status colors: טרם התחיל (gray outline) · בתהליך (amber) · סגור (sage green)
· Priority chip: הכרחי / לוגיסטי / אסתטי / אישי — each with distinct color
· FAB (+) add task · Empty state illustration
· Vendor cards: photo / price range / stars
· Advance paid / balance / last payment date
· Unit: per item / per guest / per hour
4 task type variants — rendered based on task.type field
· Task name (required) · Type: Vendor / Payment / Decision / Reminder (icon selector)
· Category chips · Priority: הכרחי / לוגיסטי / אסתטי / אישי · Responsible person chip
· Event dropdown · Due date picker (optional) · Notes textarea (optional)
· Champagne gold donut ring (% spent of total)
· Gifts & breakeven card: income − expenses delta
· Scrollable category rows: icon / name / spent / budget / bar
· FAB (+) add expense · "Edit total budget" link
· Billing unit: per item / per guest / per hour
owns: all events, guests, tasks, budget
drives: event pill tabs across all pages
type drives: Vendor / Payment / Decision / Reminder view
linked from Task (vendor type) + Budget rows
